answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The spiral of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the tide until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the knoll of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
